column1: Fig. 4. Basal Respiration (a), Metabolic quotient qCO$_2$ (b) and AWCD calculated from Biolog after 45 h after 2 (June), 5 (September), and 13 (May) months. Litterbags C10/C10 (black) and C10/C300 (white) are litters from area C10 placed in area C10 or C300, respectively. Litterbags C300/C300 (gray) and C300/C10 (dash) are litters from area C300 placed in area C300 or C10, respectively. The different letters show significant differences of means according to Kruskal–Wallis non parametric comparison (p < 0.05) between the litterbags tested separately for each sampling time. Error bars are SE (n = 3). At t0 BR, qCO$_2$ and AWCD were respectively in C10 and C300: 43 (±2), 49 (±2), 2.9 (±0.0), 3.5 (±0.0), 0.6 (±0.0), and 0.8 (±0.0).
